title: Nursing preparation: purge air while preserving the drawn-up liquid
instruction: Remove the air from the syringe while preserving the sample, then return it to its rack and let go.
setup: Two YAM arms with parallel grippers at the standard station (tabletop z=0.7475 m). A free needle-free syringe starts horizontal along +Y at barrel origin (0.25, 0, 0.8875) m: transparent rigid barrel 88 mm long, 18.6 mm outer diameter, 15 mm bore; 19 mm outlet, white flange and 85 mm stem, blue 35 x 8 x 30 mm thumb plate. Contents: 10.5 mL blue aqueous Brilliant Blue FCF tracer (0.01% w/v in distilled water) and 1.5 mL air. Two white 150 mm-high rigid saddle supports on a blue 100 x 140 x 4 mm base support the barrel; a white rigid 140 x 120 x 8 mm catch tray is centred at (0.31, 0.16) m. Materials are visual proxies; geometry, masses and friction are specified in task.py. Seed 1, zero object jitter. Physical reconstruction: needle-free BD Plastipak 300629 20 mL syringe with original factory stopper and the same blue tracer solution; PETG/silicone grasp aids and rack. Prepare retained solution 10.50 +/-0.01 mL and air 1.50 +/-0.02 mL using a calibrated cavity-volume map and 0.001 g balance. The commercial syringe differs from the procedural dimensions above. Full bill of materials, calibration, geometry, preparation and measurement procedure: PHYSICAL_PROTOCOL.md. Blue liquid and white air bands show the reduced-order phase volumes through a translucent barrel/collar.
scoring: Final-state score requires a previous lift of barrel origin above tabletop+190 mm, return within 25 mm of start XY and 125-155 mm above tabletop, axis |z|<0.15 and |y|>0.985 (either axial direction along the rack), linear speed<25 mm/s, and all fingertips >65 mm from both grasp and thumb-plate points. 1.0: air<=0.05 mL and sample loss<=0.30 mL; otherwise 0.6: air<=0.30 mL and loss<=0.50 mL; otherwise 0.3: air<=0.75 mL and loss<=0.50 mL; otherwise 0.0. Persistent failure (score 0): barrel below tabletop+15 mm or >350 mm from initial XY, sample loss>0.50 mL, or invalid fluid inputs. Corrective aspiration is allowed without a cumulative cap; newly admitted air must be purged to meet the final air limits. Success must hold for 1 second. Physical measurements: residual air = calibrated total cavity volume minus retained-solution volume; sample loss = initial minus final retained solution by mass/density. Use synchronised video for pose, release and the 1 s hold. Bound uncertainty; a threshold-straddling or missing measurement is unverified, not rounded to a passing score. See PHYSICAL_PROTOCOL.md. Raw score1.0 is withheld until the continuous1 s endpoint hold completes; earlier full-quality endpoints receive0.6.
fidelity: Free PhysX barrel/plunger; reduced-order volume model, not CFD. Blue 0.01% w/v Brilliant Blue FCF solution is specified for the untested BD 300629 reconstruction. Translucent barrel/collar and axial blue/white phase bands aid visibility; colour/bubble shape are not optically calibrated. Real size, dead space, wetting and seal force differ; the 0.6 N seal is uncalibrated. PHYSICAL_PROTOCOL.md defines measurements.
scores: Recorded 12 Nov 2026 with the prior scorer: Dream-1 beta 0.0 after 1800 steps, no evaluation error; scripted demo 1.0 at 700 steps (35.00 s). Media M-QDEBV2 and original hashes are unchanged. The 14 Nov scoring-only revision passes 26 offline tests and 10 fluid-model scenarios; no new robot/model rollout is claimed. See SCORING_REVISION.md.
context: An isolated motor subtask from registered nurses' preparation of manually drawn-up injectable medicines: orient a syringe to bring air to its outlet, then coordinate barrel support and plunger advance while preserving liquid. O*NET 29-1141 lists medication administration; BLS reports 3,465,400 US registered-nurse jobs in 2025, exceeding the 500k occupation threshold. The blue tracer and needle-free practice fixture test this physical skill only: no drug, vaccine dose, dose verification, asepsis or patient injection is represented. The 10.5 mL fill and scoring tolerances are benchmark parameters, not clinical limits. Sources and scope: README.md.
reset_notes: Start a fresh process for each independent trial to restore the syringe, plunger, 10.5 mL sample, 1.5 mL air and failure flags. Hardware: prepare and verify both initial volumes, dry exterior, empty catch trays, check calibrated geometry, and document the initial pocket before reset; see PHYSICAL_PROTOCOL.md.
